title: Switching Primer
scenario: Welcome to Switching. Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) logically segments a switch at Layer 2. Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) prevents Layer 2 loops by blocking redundant paths. Media Access Control (MAC) addresses are 48-bit Layer 2 hardware addresses. Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) resolves IP addresses to MAC addresses on local networks.
question: Which protocol prevents Layer 2 loops in switched networks?
explanation: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) prevents Layer 2 loops by blocking redundant paths.
